name: Burgs (The Art of Meditation)
reason: Strict health rule: his own site, theartofmeditation.org, sells 'The Anxiety Programme' (a £60 self-paced course that promises to help relieve anxiety and manage insomnia) in its main course menu, next to 'The Art of Self-Healing', 'Level 2: Healing Meditation' and a 'healing weekend' retreat, so a listing would send people to condition-sold pages even with those items left out.
